lines.text: My lights started blinking. They're not plugged in.
I hung them the day after Thanksgiving.
That night, they turned on by themselves.
Short, short, short. Long, long, long.
My neighbor stared out his window and went pale.

lines.say: That's Morse code, he mouthed. S. O. S.

lines.text: I yanked the plug out of the wall.
Then every house on the street lit up too.
Same pattern. All the way down the block.
My neighbor wasn't at his window anymore.
Then the message changed. It spelled my name.
They're still blinking. And they're still unplugged.
